MASTER SERVICES AND NON-DISCLOSURE AGREEMENT

This Master Services and Non-Disclosure Agreement ("Agreement") is entered into
between Acme Cloud Inc. ("Vendor") and the customer ("Buyer").

1. Term and Renewal
This Agreement shall commence on the Effective Date and continue for an initial
term of one year. Thereafter it shall automatically renew for successive
one-year terms unless either party provides written notice of non-renewal at
least ninety (90) days before the end of the then-current term.

2. Fees and Payment
Buyer shall pay all fees within net 90 days of invoice. A late charge of 5% per
month shall accrue on any overdue amount until paid in full.

3. Limitation of Liability
Vendor shall not be liable for any and all damages arising out of this
Agreement. Buyer shall be liable for any and all damages, losses, and expenses
of any kind, without limitation of liability.

4. Indemnification
Buyer shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Vendor from and against any and
all claims, damages, and expenses arising out of or relating to this Agreement,
including Vendor's own negligence.

5. Intellectual Property
Buyer hereby assigns all right, title, and interest in and to any and all
intellectual property, work product, and materials created in connection with
this Agreement to Vendor.

6. Non-Competition
For a period of five (5) years following termination, Buyer shall not compete
with Vendor anywhere in the world in any line of business.

7. Confidentiality
The Receiving Party shall keep confidential all information disclosed by the
Vendor and shall not disclose it to any third party.

8. Amendments
Vendor reserves the right to modify these terms at any time in its sole
discretion, effective upon posting.

9. Governing Law and Venue
This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of Delaware, and the
parties submit to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts located in Delaware.

10. Dispute Resolution
Any dispute shall be resolved by binding arbitration, and each party waives any
right to a jury trial or to participate in a class action.

11. Warranties
The services are provided "AS IS" without warranty of any kind, and Vendor
disclaims all warranties including any warranty of merchantability or fitness
for a particular purpose.
